brand.name: CIVIO BUILD
brand.tagline: Professional Construction Project Management Consultancy (PMC) Platform

target_roles.key_focus: Central Management Command Center: Projects overview, resource assignments, activities, Gantt/milestones, client approvals queue, defect severity register, procurement tracking in INR, audit log, PDF reports generation.
Mobile-First Operational Portal: Assigned site projects, quick progress % slider, daily site logs, photo capture/upload with captions & location tags, instant defect logger, material request forms.

Transparent Executive Showcase: Simplified project health meters, site phase progress, high-res approved site photo gallery, single-click Approve/Reject workflow with feedback, downloadable client progress reports.

visual_archetype.name: Archetype 1 + Tactical Precision (Organic Forest & Construction Architectural)
visual_archetype.mood: Authoritative, precise, grounded, high-trust engineering precision. Avoids cheap SaaS blues; leans into deep forest greens, crisp structural charcoal, warm bone neutrals, and signal alerts for safety/defects.

interactive_components_strategy.role_switcher: Sticky top bar or header profile toggle letting users seamlessly switch between Admin/PM, Site Engineer, and Client views with realistic mock state pre-populated.
interactive_components_strategy.progress_approval_modal: Shadcn Dialog with timeline history of approval decisions (Draft -> Submitted -> Reviewed -> Pending Client Decision -> Approved/Rejected). Includes feedback comment box.
interactive_components_strategy.defect_register: Filterable data table with severity badges (Critical red, Major amber, Minor gray), status toggles, photo thumbnail popovers, assigned engineer avatar, and resolution deadline.
interactive_components_strategy.procurement_ledger: INR formatted summary cards (Total Budget, Spent to Date, Outstanding POs) + detailed breakdown table with status pills (Paid, Pending, Overdue).
interactive_components_strategy.site_photo_gallery: Filterable by project phase (Foundation, Superstructure, MEP, Finishing) with lightbox view, site engineer timestamp, and client approval badge.
interactive_components_strategy.pdf_exporter: Generate clean printable PDF summary report trigger with dynamic formatting for client sign-off.

test_id_rules.mandatory_pattern: Every interactive button, tab, role selector, input field, modal trigger, status badge, and filter dropdown MUST include explicit data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Replace standard Vercel dark/blue defaults with Deep Forest Green (#132E23 / #1B4332) and charcoal structural card backgrounds.
2. Implement role-based navigation with realistic sample data for 3 distinct PMC user personas (Admin/PM, Site Engineer, Client).
3. Support the full progress-update lifecycle states: Draft, Submitted, Reviewed, Pending Client Decision, Approved, Rejected, Clarification Needed.
4. All monetary figures must be strictly formatted in INR (₹) with Indian numerical units (Lakh, Cr).
5. Use Shadcn components for dialogs, tabs, dropdowns, tables, sonner toasts, and progress meters, but apply custom forest-green and charcoal styling.
6. Ensure site engineer interface has a clear mobile view layout with large touch targets for site photo upload and daily report submissions.
7. Include interactive PDF export simulation or printable view for client status reports.
8. Include data-testid attributes on all interactive elements without exception.
